The volume geometry is subdivided into polygons.
- If divided into triangles, the hardware performs linear interpolation across each triangle.
- If divided into trapezoids via horizontal lines through vertices, the hardware performs bilinear interpolation within trapezoids, or linear interpolation if a trapezoid degenerates into a triangle.
- **View Dependence:** The interpolation is view-dependent because the subdivision into pieces depends on the view plane polygon subdivision and any further hardware subdivision.
